editorial:
Imagine having a daughter who can start fires just by getting angry. That is the crazy situation Andy and Vicky are dealing with in this flick. They have spent years hiding from a scary government agency that wants to turn their girl, Charlie, into a living weapon. The vibe is a mix of a family road trip and a spy thriller, with a lot of tension as Charlie grows up and finds it harder to keep her flames under control. You really feel for the parents as they try to protect their kid while staying one step ahead of the bad guys.

The action scenes are cool, and the lead actors do a great job making the family bond feel real. While the story moves a bit slow in the middle, the payoff at the end is satisfying. If you like stories about kids with superpowers and government conspiracies, you will dig this. You should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see the fire effects look their best, or you can grab the 4K Blu-ray if you like owning your movies. It is a solid choice for a movie night with the family.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, Charlie finally stops running and uses her full power to fight back against the agency. She lets her anger take over and burns down the facility and the bad guys who tried to capture her. After the chaos, she manages to save her parents and escape. The movie ends with the family finally finding some peace, knowing that the people hunting them are gone for good.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves sci-fi movies about kids with special powers.
